name: sway
summary: i3-compatible tiling Wayland compositor. Plain-text config in i3 syntax, splits/tabs/stacking containers, inner and outer gaps, swaymsg IPC. No rounded corners or blur (those need the SwayFX fork).

install.notes: Debian and Ubuntu; testing/unstable carry 1.12, stable releases may lag (trixie has 1.10.1). Add foot or another terminal.
Fedora; Rawhide and 45 have 1.12, 43 and 44 have 1.11. The sway-config-upstream and sway-config-minimal packages hold the default config.

linux.notes: Latest release at verification: 1.12 (2026-05-25). Config search order: ~/.sway/config, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/sway/config, ~/.i3/config, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/i3/config, /etc/sway/config, /etc/i3/config. The default config is usually /etc/sway/config; copy it to ~/.config/sway/config before editing. Run from a TTY with sway or pick it in a display manager (supported officially since 1.12). Wayland only; X11 apps run through Xwayland (match them by class instead of app_id).

borders.notes: Width and colors only. No rounded corners in sway itself (SwayFX adds them).
